```{r Library}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r import data}
gtdbtk <- read_tsv("gtdbtk/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv")
gtdbtk
metabat_66 <- read_tsv("prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv")
metabat_66
```

```{r first try at tidy}
gtdbtk |>
  separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |> 
  group_by(user_genome) |>
  slice_tail(n=3) |> 
  summarise(short_classification=paste(classification, collapse = " "))
```

```{r tidy table}
gtdbk_taxonomy <- gtdbtk |> 
separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |> # split the 
  mutate(rank= str_extract(classification, "^[dpcofgs](?=__)")) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rank, 
    values_from = classification
  ) |> 
   rename(
    domain  = d,
    phylum  = p,
    class   = c,
    order   = o,
    family  = f,
    genus   = g,
    species = s
  ) |> 
  mutate(across(
    c(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species),
    ~ str_remove(.x, "^[a-z]__")
  )) |> 
  select(user_genome, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species)

gtdbk_taxonomy
```
